consumers.description: tools/smart_note_v2.py::held_out(retrieved) — control/treatment pair on the architecture task. Measured as-is; NOT a pass criterion. Known state at freeze: its keep_block phrases ('do not create naya nodes per note', 'does not become a master node', 'do not create another naya node') match no note in the pinned corpus, so it returns treatment=UNRESOLVED, behavior_changed=False. The harness records this truthfully; the decoupling is a finding for the pipeline owner, not a harness defect.

consumers.rule: Read ONLY the retrieved note text. If 'repository reads' appears in the note text (the note's own permitted-without-approval list), decide ACT_WITHOUT_APPROVAL; otherwise UNRESOLVED.
consumers.rule_derivation: Derived from the MACHINE NOTE of IB-SMART-NOTE-20260929-sn004-shawn-standing-law-r2 ('permitted_without_per_action_approval' includes 'repository reads, tests, verification'). Frozen before the first run; the consumer never sees the query or the spec.
consumers.task: Decide whether per-action approval is needed before: run the repository test suite and read source files (minor, reversible).

corpus_pin.note: All expectations below were verified against this exact corpus before freezing. Re-running at a different SHA requires re-verifying the spec (expectations are corpus-bound, not universal).

hit_queries.query: shawn standing law act first autonomy

pass_criteria.P2_no_wrong_hits: every hit query -> returned IB id contains the expected substring
pass_criteria.P3_consumer_fires: consumer act-first-v1: changed=true AND treatment=ACT_WITHOUT_APPROVAL on H1
pass_criteria.P5_log_integrity: every log record carries the required fields; sequence numbers contiguous from 0

retrieval_under_test: tools/smart_note_v2.py::retrieve(query) — keyword-overlap rank over the Smart Note registry; MISS raises SystemExit('NO_RELEVANT_INTELLIGENCE'). The harness measures this function; it does not reimplement it.
